notes.title: Update 1.9.0
notes.content: [h1][b]Update 1.9.0[/b][/h1][p]After a slight delay, the time has finally come. The next update is ready. The biggest new feature in this update is the new game mode "Quick Battle." For now, there are only two maps (one on Grimstar and one on Atell). All upgrades are unlocked in this mode. You can freely choose the difficulty and opponent. Loading and saving are also possible, of course.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/a9ac6ba3b4b8a6c2d7a9b19749a6c35a0dc8ea38.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Changes that have been implemented[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The range of the Mini Gun has been increased[/p][/*][*][p]New game mode "Quick Battle"[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bugs that have been fixed[/b][/h2][list][*][p]In some places, the maps on Atell were not properly accessible, and units would get stuck on the map. This has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]What happens next?[/b][/h1][p]The next update is planned to add more content, such as new upgrades, units, and buildings. There will also be more maps for the "Quick Battle" game mode.[/p][p]Due to the summer holidays in Germany, the next update won't be released until the end of September. Unless, of course, critical bugs have crept in.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.8.0
notes.content: [h1][b]Update 1.8.0[/b][/h1][p]As announced, the first update is now available with the first new content. This includes a new unit, a new upgrade, and a new building.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/d092cf3149587ff53b45026cd4f47f720b1287e1.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Changes that have been implemented[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New upgrade "Radar" that allows you to reveal parts of the map for a short time.[/p][/*][*][p]New unit "Drone." This is a fast unit with a long visibility range but is unarmed.[/p][/*][*][p]New building "Watchtower." This building is heavily armored and can be manned by soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p]The first mission has been slightly revised and is now easier to complete.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]What happens next?[/b][/h1][p]The next update plans to add more content, such as new upgrades, units and buildings.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.content: [h1][b]Update 1.7.0[/b][/h1][p]First of all, thank you again for the extensive and detailed feedback I received from you on the last update. Based on your feedback, I've implemented further changes in a subsequent update and have also been able to fix some critical bugs.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bugs that have been fixed[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Friendly units no longer disappear into the walls in the indoor mission on Atel.[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Russian and Chinese translations have been added and corrected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Changes that have been implemented[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You can set waypoints for your own units when moving them (using the Add key)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/33fa19a7fb74cd8d59ff3771a805b3ef541df592.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The "Bloom" effect can now be reduced or completely turned off in the display settings[/p][/*][*][p]The silhouette from the last update can now be deactivated in the settings[/p][/*][*][p]The penultimate mission has been slightly reworked and is now less difficult to complete.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]What happens next?[/b][/h1][p]The next update is planned to add some more content, such as new upgrades, units and buildings.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.content: [h1][b]Update 1.6.0[/b][/h1][p]Thank you very much for the numerous and detailed feedback I've received from you. This is a great help in further improving the game. Based on your feedback, I've implemented initial changes in the update and have also been able to identify and fix critical bugs.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bugs that have been fixed[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The enemy AI has been revised and balanced. A few bugs have been fixed. For example, the pirates were able to build new units with almost no resources. Additionally, some units would sometimes get stuck in the enemy base, resulting in far too many units waiting in the base and making it almost impossible to destroy pirate bases (except with the plasma cannon). In some missions, enemy units could shoot through walls with factories, and due to the bug, they weren't automatically attacked by their own units.[/p][/*][*][p]Maintenance units and worker drones now return to the location where the player placed them after automatically repairing units and buildings. This prevents them from accidentally spreading across the map.[/p][/*][*][p]The bug where you could no longer select the next mission after completing the 3rd mission on Atell (the screen remained partially black) has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Changes that have been implemented[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Friendly units now have a silhouette to make them easier and faster to spot. This silhouette is visible even when units are behind trees or buildings. Enemy units also have this silhouette, but in red. This makes units and enemies much more visible, for example, when fighting in the forest.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/f00119daad761b25e7d2704a35b7910698b19f63.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]If you select unit groups using the number key and press this key twice, the camera jumps directly to the unit group[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]What happens next?[/b][/h1][p]Further updates are planned every two weeks to provide new content in addition to further improvements. Additional units, towers, and other upgrades are planned. There will also be new enemy units and buildings.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.2 is Available
notes.content: [h1]Patch 1.5.2[/h1][p]A new patch is available that fixes critical bugs that occur when loading or saving game states. For example, various towers disappear after loading. A few minor issues occurred, especially when loading or saving special missions. I've fixed these with this patch.[/p][h1]What's next?[/h1][p]In addition to further patches, there will also be a major update next month. The update will include UI improvements for faster summoning of new units. There will also be new units and towers. Details on the planned update will be available in the coming days. Thank you for your feedback and for reporting bugs; it really helps me improve the game.[/p]

notes.title: Grimstar: Prequel. Update 1.4.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hello, Corporates!

[b]The Grimstar: Prequel[/b] update 1.4.0 has been released. I would like to thank you again for all your feedback on Steam and Discord, which also made this update possible. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631250/Grimstar_Prequel/

The following are some of the major changes:

[h2]New Map Design[/h2]
A new Optical Map Design has been added, with more objects on the map. The maps should no longer look so empty.

[previewyoutube=zEKJw0vvptg;full][previewyoutube=zEKJw0vvptg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
There have been further balancing improvements made to the new enemy and player fractions. There has also been a slight update to the existing mission maps.

[h2]Bug fixing[/h2]
A number of bugs have been fixed, allowing the game to run more smoothly. One critical bug was fixed during the loading of new missions. The process has been sped up and shouldn't be interrupted any longer.

Any feedback you have about the new update would be greatly appreciated!

I look forward to seeing you out there, on the surface of a savage planet!

[h3]Ask The Dev[/h3]
You are very welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/7n3XxDW27N]Discord[/url] server to discuss more about the game.

notes.title: Grimstar: Welcome to the savage planet is coming out on October 26!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40833159/af493f4bfef6f6c833c894e642806cb4017f3bcf.jpg[/img]

Hey RTS Fans,

I’m excited to announce that after 2 years of development everything is on schedule and [b]Grimstar: Welcome to the savage planet[/b] is going to be released on [b]October 26th, 2022[/b].

Thank you for all your feedback during development! 

[h2]MORE ABOUT GRIMSTAR and THE RELEASE[/h2]

[b]Welcome to the savage planet[/b] acts as a Prologue for Grimstar: Crystals are the New Oil! You can play the first five missions of the single player campaign.

This prologue version will showcase a fresh cartoon graphic style which complements the gameplay mechanics. The following is a short summary of what I have changed for the final release version based on your feedback:

[h3]New Cartoon Graphic Style[/h3]

I've switched to a cartoon graphic style since it appears much nicer and the maps are now much clearer.
[previewyoutube=r7-oi2LZcsY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Alternate victory condition[/h3]

As an alternative to collecting all the crystals on the map, you can find and destroy all the enemies' caves. You can try it if you are brave enough, but it will be more challenging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40833159/f93249fdaa04423a8d3748d6e36b3debdcab6e24.jpg[/img]

[h3]Level Up System[/h3]

In addition, the game features a leveling up system. The amount of crystals you have at the end of each mission determines the experience reward. Therefore, playing as effectively as possible makes sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40833159/6e14ead72cc2ef9c23c9efa131b8c73044b31023.png[/img]

[h3]Hero Units [/h3]

The Game also includes the first Hero Unit. Leveling up, calling Bombers for support, and using a shield are among the things he can do.

However, Hero Units are only available if you have completed the tutorial and the first mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40833159/2a474d99de1bc04bba796c0bf6cbac4caf0ab129.png[/img]

There are also tons of bug fixes. I hope you have a good time playing the game.

[h1]Don't miss the release and [b]make the company proud![/b][/h1]

Still not added to your wishlist?

Well, it's time to do it!

This will greatly help us and provide invaluable support for the project on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631250/Grimstar_Welcome_to_the_savage_planet/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/e3a047c3676f5ec99977c66b023ad8c51ed39bbf.gif[/img]

[b]Grimstar[/b] is a Real-time Strategy game. Build your base in a hostile environment, train your army, gather resources, defend your mining operations. The more you mine - the more hostile the alien environment will become. Your ultimate goal is to completely colonize the uncharted world.

[h1]The story: [/h1]
[i]Year 3047, the elected government on Earth is long gone. Megacorporations are in control.
The earth’s resources are depleted, and the energy crisis is imminent. But there is still hope – a discovery of a distant world, which is rich in a new kind of natural energy resource. The name of the new world is “Grimstar”. Inhabited by only primitive creatures, it seemed an easy prey for aggressive colonisation and mining…
But they were deceived.
Grimstar is a real-time strategy game about exploiting a foreign planet as efficiently as possible.[/i]

notes.title: Play test
notes.content:
[h1]Starting Play test Next Week (10 January 2022)[/h1]
At First I would like to say [b]thank you[/b] for the feedback which i get after the Steam Next Fest in October last Year. I use this Feedback to change some points of the core gameplay:

[h3]Time Limit Removed[/h3]
I have removed the time limit in all missions and have replace it thought waves which getting heavier and heavier.

[h3]Commander Unit is now a Hero Unit[/h3]
Also the commander unit, which is the only unit which can summon new units, is now a Hero Unit which you can call every time if you have enough Resources.

[h3]More Enemies and Blood[/h3]
I have also raise the number of enemies in each level, but each enemy have less power than before. I do this to Increase action of the game.

[h3]Play Test[/h3]
I start a new Play test Next Week, to get more Feedback about the changes of the gameplay. The Play test is open to all players.

Any Kind of Feedback is welcome!
